messages:
anne: quick follow-up from the prefix+kv contract unification pilot. found a correctness window during cross-node handoffs that affects streaming cursors 

anne: repro in canary: demote/evict -> handoff -> reads may return items for ~200-500ms if lease-epoch updates are delayed

julia: can you paste the minimal trace?

anne: sure, simplified:

anne: ```
PUT prefix P -> node A (epoch 101)
EVICT prefix P -> tombstone, bump epoch to 102
Handoff begins -> node B claims, but cached residency on some read paths still reflects A for ~300ms
Cursor read -> observes stale presence -> returns demoted items
```

miguel: sounds like we removed a synchronous lease refresh in the unified path. that saved an RPC but opened a small race window.

sam: what's the failure impact? errors or just stale data?

anne: stale data only; not data loss. but streaming clients (long cursors) rely on demote/prefix semantics and it violates their SLOs for correctness.

liz: customers with streaming analytics will hit this. options?

anne: tradeoffs we've considered:
- keep the async path (current) and accept small window
- reintroduce forced lease-refresh/sync on handoff (adds latency/RPC)
- add targeted strong-read for active cursors and leave general path async
- make strict handoff opt-in per deployment/class of customer

julia: prefer an opt-in flag + telemetry so Hosted keeps perf default but Dedicated/Private can enable correctness.

anne: proposed actions:
1) add feature flag kv.unified.strict_handoff (default OFF)
2) re-enable the lease-refresh when flag ON (cheap revert)
3) add metric prefetch.handoff_inconsistent_reads and tracing spans for handoff+read
4) run 72h canary with flag ON for a subset of traffic + scheduled repro job
5) run chaos test (miguel) that kills owner mid-handoff

miguel: I'll wire the chaos scenario and add a unit test for lease-epoch fencing.

sam: quantify perf cost for Hosted p99. if it's small we can consider flipping sooner.

anne: microbench shows ~0.8ms p99 increase for handoff-heavy traces. will attach numbers to the ticket.

liz: SE docs + release notes needed. include config example and recommended defaults for streaming workloads.

anne: config snippet to document:

anne: ```yaml
kv:
  unified_contract: true
  unified:
    strict_handoff: true  # forces lease-refresh on handoff to eliminate stale-read window
```

julia: opsbot, open a deploy ticket for canary and attach repro job. assign anne + miguel + sam.

opsbot: Ticket RDW-ENG-9873 created: "canary: prefix-kv strict_handoff deploy + repro". Assignees: anne, miguel, sam. Canary window: 72h. Link: https://tickets.internal/9873

anne: scheduling canary for tomorrow UTC. will post results here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
